name: CAKE GOBBLES
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, EGG, VANASPATI, INTERESTERIFIED VEGETABLE FAT, HUMECTANT 422, LIQUID GLUCOSE, REFINED PALMOLEIN OIL, DEXTROSE, COCOA SOLIDS (2.1%), FRUCTOOLIGOSACCHARIDES, HIGH MALTOSE SYRUP, COLOURS (150c, 150d, 102, 122, 132, 133], CAKE GEL (EMULSIFIERS (471,477,470(i)) & HUMECTANT (1520, 422), RAISING AGENTS (341), 500), 450(vi) & 450), NATURE IDENTICAL (CHOCOLATE) & ARTIFICIAL (CREAMY VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, IODIZED SALT, PRESERVATIVES [202, 282], ACIDITY REGULATOR (330), BAKING POWDER, EMULSIFIER (475) AND STABILIZER (415).
